content.problemStatement: Write a program for the coding challenge "Berland Poker". Refer to LeetCode description: https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1359/A
content.inputFormat: The first line contains an integer T, the number of test cases. Then T test cases follow. The first line of each test case contains two integers n and k. The second line contains n integers a1, a2, ..., an.
content.outputFormat: For each test case, print the maximum number of cards that can be taken.
